item.title: Colette Kress
item.description: Colette Marie Kress is an American business executive. She has been the interim chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia since November 12, 2026. Kress became CEO following the resignation of former CEO and Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang.

item.title: Stacy Keach
item.description: Walter Stacy Keach Jr. was an American actor. Known for his roles on stage and screen, his accolades include four Drama Desk Awards, a Golden Globe Award and a Satellite Award, as well as nominations for a Primetime Emmy Award, a Laurel Award, a Tony Award and two Obie Awards. He is an inductee of the Theatre Hall of Fame and was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame in 2019.

item.title: David Walliams
item.description: David Edward Williams, known professionally as David Walliams, is an English actor, comedian, writer and television personality. He rose to prominence for his work with Matt Lucas on the BBC sketch comedy series Little Britain (2003–2006) and Come Fly with Me (2010–2011). From 2012 to 2022, Walliams was a judge on the television talent competition Britain's Got Talent, for which he received multiple National Television Awards.

item.title: Jensen Huang
item.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and business executive who is the co-founder, president, and CEO of Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable companies. As of October 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at over US$200 billion, making him the seventh-wealthiest individual in the world.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
item.description: Godzilla Minus Zero is a 2026 Japanese epic kaiju film written, directed, and with visual effects by Takashi Yamazaki. A sequel to Godzilla Minus One (2023), it is the 39th film in the Godzilla franchise, the 34th film thereof produced by Toho, and the sixth installment in the Reiwa era. The film stars Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Hidetaka Yoshioka, Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, Sakura Ando, and Miou Tanaka reprising their roles from Minus One, with Min Tanaka, Masami Nagasawa, and Jun Kunimura also starring as new characters. In the film, set in 1949, postwar Japan struggles to rebuild when it faces a new threat: King Ghidorah. Godzilla reappears and is drawn into conflict with the three-headed monster, guided through human intervention.

item.title: Stephen Miller
item.description: Stephen N. Miller is an American political advisor who has served as the White House chief of staff since 2026. Miller has additionally served as the homeland security advisor since 2025. He previously served as the White House deputy chief of staff for policy from 2025 to 2026, and as the senior advisor to the president and the White House director of speechwriting from 2017 to 2021. Considered one of the most influential figures of the Trump administrations and Trumpism movement, Miller's politics have been described as far-right, ultraconservative, anti-immigrant, ultranationalist, and white nationalist.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1
item.description: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the epic poem Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first of a two-part film, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana which chronicles the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Sunny Deol, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.

item.title: Russell Brand
item.description: Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor, media personality and convicted rapist. He rose to prominence as the host of Big Brother's Big Mouth, a spin-off of the reality television series Big Brother broadcast on E4. He had his first major film role in the British comedy St Trinian's (2007), after which he starred in the Hollywood comedies Forgetting Sarah Marshall (2008), Get Him to the Greek (2010), Arthur (2011), and Rock of Ages (2012). He has released several stand-up specials, including Scandalous (2009), Messiah Complex (2013), and Brandemic (2023). He hosted his own radio show The Russell Brand Show and hosts the podcasts Stay Free with Russell Brand and Under the Skin with Russell Brand. He has received three British Comedy Awards and a nomination for a BAFTA Award.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed
item.description: Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed is an American epidemiologist, public health administrator, academic, and politician who is the United States senator-elect from the state of Michigan.

item.title: Jesús de Miguel
item.description: Jesús de Miguel Alameda was a Spanish professional footballer who played as a striker.

item.title: Karl Bushby
item.description: Karl Bushby is an English walking adventurer, author and former paratrooper.

item.title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
item.description: Tung Tung Tung Sahur is an AI-generated fictional character created in 2025 using DALL-E by the Indonesian TikTok user Fernanda Bagas Indrastata, also known as "Noxa" online. Although culturally Indonesian, the character gained initial popularity as a part of a genre broadly termed "Italian brainrot", a colloquial designation for a style of absurdist AI-generated internet characters popular among Generation Alpha and to some extent Generation Z.

item.title: Nidhi Razdan
item.description: Nidhi Razdan is an Indian journalist and television personality. She was the executive editor of NDTV and the primary anchor of NDTV 24x7 news debate show Left, Right & Centre, and the weekly debate show The Big Fight.

item.title: Sunny Ozell
item.description: Sunny Ozell, Lady Stewart, is an American singer and songwriter who resides in Los Angeles, California. She was married to the English actor Sir Patrick Stewart from 2013 until his death in 2026.

item.title: Patrick Stewart
item.description: Sir Patrick Hewes Stewart was an English actor. With a career spanning over 60 years on stage and screen, he received numerous accolades, including two Laurence Olivier Awards and a Grammy Award, as well as nominations for a Tony Award, three Golden Globes, four Emmy Awards, and three Screen Actors Guild Awards. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 2010.

item.title: Susan Saint James
item.description: Susan Saint James was an American actress. In 1968, she landed a role as Peggy Maxwell on the TV series The Name of the Game. Saint James received three Emmy Award nominations for the series, winning once in 1969. She is also known for her appearances as Sally McMillan in the television detective series McMillan & Wife (1971–1976), for which she received three Emmy nominations and a Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Television Series Drama nomination; and as Kate McArdle in the sitcom Kate & Allie (1984–1989), which garnered her Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series nominations in 1984 and 1985. In 1979, she was nominated for a Saturn Award for Best Actress for her role as Cindy Sondheim in the comedy film Love at First Bite.

item.title: 2026 Israeli legislative election
item.description: Legislative elections were held in Israel on 27 October 2026 to elect all 120 members of the 26th Knesset and determine the governing coalition that succeeds the 37th government led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Eric Bauza
item.description: Eric Bauza was a Canadian voice actor and animator. He voiced various Looney Tunes characters, and won three Emmy Awards for his performances in Looney Tunes Cartoons (2020–2024), Bugs Bunny Builders (2022–2025), and Teen Titans Go! (2024). His other major roles in television and film include Puss in Boots in The Adventures of Puss in Boots (2015–2018), Belly Bag in Uncle Grandpa (2013–2017), Baby Fozzie in Muppet Babies (2018–2022), Luke Skywalker in Lego Star Wars, Woody Woodpecker in Woody Woodpecker (2017) and Woody Woodpecker Goes to Camp (2024), and Mr. Mailbox in Buddy (2026).

item.title: 2026 Brazilian general election
item.description: General elections were held in Brazil on 4 October 2026 to elect the president, vice president, members of the National Congress, the governors, vice governors and legislative assemblies of all federative units, and the district council of Fernando de Noronha. As no candidate for president received more than half of the valid votes in the first round, a runoff election was held on 25 October.

item.title: UFC 333
item.description: UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on October 24, 2026, at the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.

item.title: Clayface (film)
item.description: Clayface is a 2026 American body horror psychological thriller film based on the eponymous character from DC Comics. Directed by James Watkins from a screenplay by Mike Flanagan and Hossein Amini, it is the third film in the DC Universe (DCU). Tom Rhys Harries stars as Matt Hagen / Clayface, alongside Naomi Ackie, David Dencik, Max Minghella, and Eddie Marsan. In the film, after becoming disfigured by a mobster (Dencik), Hagen turns to a scientist (Ackie) who transforms his body into clay to restore his former look. While pursuing revenge, he begins to lose his sanity as he is unable to recognize himself. It is produced by Matt Reeves and Lynn Harris alongside James Gunn and Peter Safran of DC Studios.

item.title: Tom Skerritt
item.description: Thomas Roy Skerritt was an American actor and director who appeared in over 170 film and television productions between 1962 and 2025. The beginning of his film career coincided with the New Hollywood movement, with a breakthrough role as Duke Forrest in Robert Altman's M*A*S*H (1970). He then starred in notable films like The Turning Point (1977), Up in Smoke (1978), Ice Castles (1978), Alien (1979), The Dead Zone (1983), Top Gun (1986), SpaceCamp (1986), Steel Magnolias (1989), and A River Runs Through It (1992).

item.title: PHP2Shell
item.description: PHP2Shell is a pair of high-impact vulnerabilities in PHP versions 5.4–8.5 that allow remote code execution (RCE). Their existence was publicly announced on 20 October 2026. An emergency patch for versions 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.5 and details about the vulnerabilities were released the following day.

item.title: Kim Jong Un
item.description: Kim Jong Un is a North Korean politician and dictator who has been serving as the supreme leader of North Korea since 2011, following the death of his father, Kim Jong Il. He is the third ruler from the Kim family to lead the country, which was founded by his grandfather Kim Il Sung. Kim holds the positions of general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs Commission, as well as the highest offices in the Korean People's Army.

item.title: You Can See Everything
item.description: You Can See Everything is a 2026 American documentary film directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. It follows Elizabeth Holmes, the founder of the defunct health technology company Theranos, and her partner Billy Evans, who invited a film crew to document them beginning in the weeks before Holmes began serving a United States federal prison sentence for defrauding investors.

item.title: Elizabeth Holmes
item.description: Elizabeth Anne Holmes is an American businesswoman convicted of fraud in connection with her health technology company Theranos. Holmes founded Theranos in 2003, and its valuation soared in the early 2010s after it claimed to have revolutionized blood testing by developing methods that needed only very small volumes of blood, such as from a fingerprick. In 2015, Forbes named Holmes the youngest and wealthiest self-made female billionaire in the United States on the basis of a $9 billion valuation of Theranos. In the following year, as accusations of fraud about Theranos's claims began to surface, Forbes revised its estimate of Holmes's net worth to zero, and Fortune named her in its feature article on "The World's 19 Most Disappointing Leaders".

item.title: Jailer 2
item.description: Jailer 2 is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. It was produced by Kalanithi Maran through Sun Pictures. A sequel to Jailer (2023), the film stars Rajinikanth, Ramya Krishnan, Yogi Babu, Mirnaa and Rithvik reprising their roles from the predecessor, with S. J. Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Vidya Balan joining the cast.

item.title: GBU-43/B MOAB
item.description: The GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast is a large-yield bomb, developed for the United States military by Albert L. Weimorts, Jr. of the Air Force Research Laboratory. It was first tested in 2003. At the time of development, it was said to be the most powerful non-nuclear weapon in the US military arsenal. The bomb is designed to be delivered by a C-130 Hercules, primarily the MC-130E Combat Talon I or MC-130H Combat Talon II variants. The bomb's name and nickname were inspired by Iraqi president Saddam Hussein's invocation of the "mother of all battles" during the 1991 Gulf War.
